label: Whether the white matter hyperintensity (WMH) segmentation is useable - Cross-sectional - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Whether the white matter hyperintensity (WMH) segmentation is useable - Cross-sectional - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 white matter hyperintensity volumes (global and regional) generated using the cross-sectional Bayesian Model Selection (BaMoS) pipeline . Note that there is also a longitudinal phase 1 white matter hyperintensity volume dataset which was generated after phase 2 data collection was complete - library file I46P2_Bamos_L.
cat_rows: This category contains the cross-sectional variables related to the white matter hyperintensity volumnes generated using the Bayesian Model Seletion (BaMoS) pipeline from the MRI brain imaging carried out on the participants taking part in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
